from collections import Counter
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hrows=[i for i in range(H) if Counter(g[i]).most_common(1)[0][0]!=bg and Counter(g[i]).most_common(1)[0][1]>=len(g[i])*0.5]
